subject: Operating Systems (CS304 / PCC-CS402)
curriculum_standard: Indian Technical University Standard (AICTE Model / VTU / Anna Univ / AKTU / Mumbai Univ)

topics.name: OS Services & Dual Mode Operation
topics.exam_pattern: Short answer 2-5 marks. Often low yield compared to numericals.

topics.name: System Calls (fork, exec, wait)
topics.exam_pattern: Repeated question: fork() tracing code snippets (2-3 times in last 5 years).

topics.name: Process States & PCB Lifecycle
topics.exam_pattern: State transition diagram is a guaranteed 5-mark question; unlocks CPU Scheduling.

topics.name: CPU Scheduling Algorithms (FCFS, SJF, SRTF, Round Robin)
topics.exam_pattern: Guaranteed 10-12 marker numerical: Gantt chart + Turnaround Time + Waiting Time calculation (100% past 5 years).
topics.high_probability_question: Given 5 processes with Arrival & Burst times, draw Gantt Chart for SRTF and Round Robin (q=2) and calculate avg TAT and WT.

topics.name: Multithreading Models & Thread Libraries
topics.exam_pattern: Theory 1:1, M:1, M:M models. Often comes in internal choice against scheduling numerical.

topics.name: Critical Section Problem & Semaphores
topics.exam_pattern: Mutual exclusion criteria + wait()/signal() code definitions.

topics.name: Classical Synchronization: Producer-Consumer & Readers-Writers
topics.exam_pattern: Guaranteed 8-10 marker code/pseudo-code implementation using semaphores.
topics.high_probability_question: Explain bounded-buffer Producer-Consumer problem using counting and binary semaphores with full pseudo-code.

topics.name: Banker's Algorithm for Deadlock Avoidance
topics.exam_pattern: Guaranteed 10-marker numerical (Need matrix, Safety algorithm sequence, Resource request algorithm). 90%+ occurrence.
topics.high_probability_question: Given Allocation, Max, and Available matrices for 5 processes and 3 resource types, determine if system is in safe state. If request arrives for P1(1,0,2), can it be granted?

topics.name: Paging Hardware, TLB & Address Translation
topics.exam_pattern: Address translation diagram (Page # + Offset) and Effective Memory Access Time (EMAT) numerical.

topics.name: Page Replacement Algorithms (FIFO, LRU, Optimal)
topics.exam_pattern: Guaranteed 8-10 marker numerical: Given page reference string with 3/4 frames, calculate page faults.
topics.high_probability_question: Consider reference string: 7, 0, 1, 2, 0, 3, 0, 4, 2, 3, 0, 3, 2, 1, 2, 0, 1, 7, 0, 1 with 3 frames. Calculate page faults for FIFO and LRU.

topics.name: Segmentation & Thrashing
topics.exam_pattern: Short note on Thrashing causes and working set model (5 marks).

topics.name: Disk Scheduling Algorithms (FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN)
topics.exam_pattern: Easiest numerical in OS: Total head movements calculation for given cylinder track requests. High return, low effort.
topics.high_probability_question: Disk queue: 98, 183, 37, 122, 14, 124, 65, 67. Head at 53. Calculate total cylinder movements for SCAN and SSTF.

topics.name: File Allocation Methods (Contiguous, Linked, Indexed)
topics.exam_pattern: Comparative theory question, low scoring variance.

topics.name: RAID Levels Architecture
topics.exam_pattern: Rarely appears as a compulsory question; high memorization cost.
